findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素揭露：第三方（欲競爭器械或維修市場者）與部分客戶已對公司提出反壟斷訴訟；公司業務受美國與歐盟反壟斷法規範。
findings.excerpt: Also, antitrust claims have been brought against us by third parties looking to compete in the instruments or servicing space and by certain customers.

findings.claim: 10-K 披露歐盟執委會於 2025-12-16 發布 EU MDR 針對性修訂提案，預期 2027 年前不會通過。
findings.excerpt: On December 16, 2025, the European Commission published a targeted revision proposal of the EU MDR to address structural issues, certification delays, and burdens on small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). The proposal will enter the ordinary legislative procedure and is not expected to be adopted before 2027.

findings.claim: 第九巡迴法庭 2026-08 撤銷 SIS 反壟斷案原判（陪審團指示錯誤）並發回地方法院；Intuitive 2026-09-28 聲請全院重審
findings.source: Bloomberg Tax：Surgical Robot Monopoly Suit Revived Over Jury Instructions
findings.excerpt: A trial court gave incorrect jury instructions on how to assess whether Intuitive Surgical Inc. unfairly cornered the repair market for its line of “da Vinci” systems, the US Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit said Thursday. The trial court was too demanding in what plaintiff Surgical Instrument Service Co.
